name: NFPA 110 generator + ATS log-freshness audit (BIM-side only)
description: Audits BIM parameter timestamps only — does NOT trigger physical tests. NFPA 110 weekly load tests and monthly ATS transfer tests must be conducted and logged manually by the facilities team; this workflow verifies that those logs have been recorded in the model within the required intervals (generator ≤ 35 days, ATS ≤ 35 days, UPS battery ≤ 4 years).
_readOnlyNote: Declared, and PROVEN by tools/check_smoke_test.py: every commandTag below resolves to a class carrying [Transaction(TransactionMode.ReadOnly)]. Adding a writer to this preset fails CI. Also checked by hand on 2026-08-22 for file I/O, because the gate only proves the Revit transaction mode: none of these commands writes a document, log or export to disk either. That second half is NOT enforced by CI - if you add a step that renders or exports, this note stops being true before the gate notices.

steps.label: EesResilienceValidator: check EES_GEN_TEST_LOG_DT, EES_ATS_TEST_LOG_DT, and EES_UPS_BATTERY_DT freshness against NFPA 110 intervals — flags overdue logs only, does not perform or schedule physical tests
